<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Request" name="IT solution request submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rollout" name="New solution rolled out"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or Department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_IT"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_Submit" name="Submit request" sourceRef="Participant_Requester" targetRef="StartEvent_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_Deliver" name="Deliver solution" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Participant_Requester"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="IT Solution Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Request" messageRef="Message_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Assess" name="Assess request (compatibility, cost and resources)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department" messageRef="Message_Rollout">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Provide training (if needed)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Support" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Supported" name="Solution supported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_Assess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Assess" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="End_Rejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Task_Support"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_Support" targetRef="End_Supported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
